# QYL0107: Redundant [NoTrace]

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.OpenTelemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Severity | Info |

| Analyzer | `Qyl0107RedundantNoTraceAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

The [NoTrace] attribute is used to opt a method out of class-level [Traced] auto-instrumentation. When the declaring type does not have [Traced], the [NoTrace] attribute has no effect and should be removed to avoid confusion.
